subjects.description: Keep device-authorized sessions across restarts, with explicit Sign out and exact authority validation.
acceptance_criteria: Device grants persist in the platform vault after quit; pasted tokens remain session-only.
Visible Sign out deletes access token, refresh token, and binding.
Restart verifies provenance and lifetime before resume; refresh retries stay within token validity.

audit_verdict.note: Current shutdown policy and process-local catalog inspected; this review chooses a policy, not implementation acceptance.

detail_sections.heading: Decision scope
items: Approval selects the product policy for implementation and focused verification.
No credential operation or network request is performed by this review.
The existing application currently deletes credentials on orderly shutdown.

subjects.description: Require device sign-in on each new launch and leave persistent-session behavior unimplemented.
acceptance_criteria: Orderly quit continues to delete access and refresh tokens.
